cases.topic: Q panel target and rejection reasons
original: この照準方向へヒモ足場を作る
Q：この方向へヒモ足場を作る
足場にできません／ヒモを{最低残量}以上残してください
cases.previous_proposal: 2つのフックの間に橋を作る／使うヒモ {n}／Q 橋を作る。表示は橋用フック接続時。
revision: 有効な組が特定できる場合：2つのフックの間に橋を作る／作ると使うヒモ {n}／実行可能時だけ Q 橋を作る
残量不足：橋を作ったあとも、ヒモを{最低残量}以上残してください。
原因未特定：この状態では橋を作れません。
cases.display: Current Tutorial popup: attached, unlocked (T3 onward via CurrentPlatformCost), positive active cost, body/camera available and point in front of camera. Not restricted to bridge-pair hooks. Proposed target text requires resolved pair; an invalid-connection reason must not disappear by narrowing the entire panel.
must_keep: Q target is authored paired hooks, not direction/player position
Cost n is ActiveRopeLength, only spent by successful Q
Minimum reserve is dynamic and means at least, not an exact required remaining value
Length advice only when distance/length failure is actually identified; CanBuild=false alone is insufficient
Main normal HUD has no same pre-Q popup
cases.counterexample: Restricting the whole popup to valid bridge hooks hides the U02 invalid-target message. Treating every failure as short length or a right-green target can misdirect a different failure.

original: 次に使う長さ {selected} / {selectableMaximum} 接続中
W / S 次に使う長さを変更
cases.previous_proposal: 次に使う長さを選ぶ（未接続時）。残量と次の長さを保持。
revision: HUDの「ヒモ残量」「次に使う長さ」は維持し、「長さ」1項目へ統合しない。
W / S 次に使う長さを選ぶ（未接続時）
必要な補足：Wで長く、Sで短く。接続中に変えるには、いったんEで外す。
cases.display: Two values remain in normal HUD. Length-changing condition belongs in help/length-related guidance; not a claim that keys work inside the open modal.
must_keep: Remaining current/max is spendable resource, not selected rope length/selectable max
Selected value is used at next attachment; it also contributes to F aim search range
Current attached cost does not change with W/S; existing UpdateSelectedRopeLength returns while attached
F aim must be in reach; do not claim every distant blue hook can be removed
Do not simplify colors to green=Q possible, blue=Q impossible
cases.counterexample: A single short label 長さ can make resource 39 look like a selected length, or make W/S appear to change an already attached rope. Saying selected length has no other effect conflicts with F aim range.

original: Eで外し、W / Sで長さ6～7を選ぶ
もう一度 Eで掛け、トゲの上を渡る
cases.previous_proposal: 詳しいヒント：Eで外し、W/Sで6〜7にして試す。
revision: 詳しいヒント：ヒモを外した状態で、W/Sで6〜7を選び、Eで掛ける。
cases.display: T2 full guide, read via Z. OpenGuide disables RopeController; its OnDisable detaches. Closing restores enabled state, not the old attachment.
must_keep: Adjustment is while detached
E toggles attachment: do not prescribe an extra detach press after guide reading
6–7 remains a reference/help value, not the only legal length or guaranteed pass
Keep the short causal statement before the number; no new hint hierarchy implemented
cases.counterexample: If a player opens Z while attached, the code detaches. After closing, following Eで外す attaches instead, then W/S returns without changing length. This is a conditional code trace, not observed input.

cases.topic: T3 example versus actual Q cost
original: 残量を7使ってできた橋を歩いて渡る
cases.previous_proposal: 体のヒモを7使い、橋として残します。99 → 92。T3看板とQ実行前。
revision: T3看板：体のヒモを7使い、橋に残します。99 → 92（残量99で長さ7を使った例）。
Q実行前：作ると使うヒモ {n}。nは今の接続長で表示する。
cases.display: The authored T3 guide/diagram can use the 7-length example. The pre-Q popup is dynamic and may be used after a different valid selected length.
must_keep: Body becomes path and Q spends rope
Recommended length is not a required exact match
Never replace dynamic actual cost with a hard-coded 7 or imply remaining is always 99
The already-fixed 99→92 diagram is not reopened as a bug
cases.counterexample: A player using another valid length would be misled if the proposed fixed 7-cost sentence were reused as the live pre-Q amount.

cases.topic: F bridge merge versus S3 switch
original: F 中央Hookを外してまとめる
F：帰り道のスイッチを押す
cases.previous_proposal: ヒモを外し、2本が集まる中央を狙う。S3のスイッチでは戻り足場を出す。T4補助は左右に長さ6の橋を1本ずつ。
revision: 橋統合の主行：F 中央フックを外し、橋を1本にする。
橋統合の補足：ヒモを外した状態で、届く範囲の中央フックを狙う。橋が2本そろってから。
T4補助：左岸と中央、中央と右岸に、長さ6の橋を1本ずつ作る。
S3現場：F：帰り道のスイッチを押す（原文維持）。
cases.display: Bridge F is unlocked Tutorial T4 onward / Main S9 onward, requires detached, aimed in reach and exactly two touching bridges. S3 switch is a separate nearby trigger interaction when stairs hidden; it does not test rope attachment or aim.
must_keep: Do not make every F interaction require aiming/detaching
Switch requires proximity, player enabled and timeScale>0; already revealed stairs do not re-trigger
Tutorial full guide closes with Z; if already detached, no extra E press is required
F merge has no new spend/refund; it removes support and changes path shape
Bridge and ordinary supporting terrain/return steps are not all called 橋
cases.counterexample: A global F note saying to detach and aim could make a player aim at the S3 switch or unnecessarily toggle E. Conversely a global F=press nearby would omit the merge aim requirement.

original: R 現在の区間から再挑戦
R この区間から再挑戦
cases.previous_proposal: Rで、直前の復帰地点から。橋とヒモ残量も、その地点に保存された状態へ戻ります。（08）
revision: 失敗/通常プレイの主行：R 直前の復帰地点から。
補足：橋・外したフック・ヒモ残量・選んだ長さも、その地点の状態に戻ります。
cases.display: Applies to checkpoint retry in normal play / after failure reveal. It is not the label for R on clear screens, which restarts Tutorial or Main. U13 stage-selection warning still means stage restart on reentry.
must_keep: Snapshot state, not always maximum resource / no bridges
Selected length and removed hook restoration must not be contradicted
No promise to preserve current attachment or velocity
Keep visible clear-screen R purpose distinct
Do not describe this as normal bridge refund
cases.counterexample: After F, R can restore the removed center hook; after changing W/S, R can restore the saved selection. Saying only that rope comes back can sound like all progress remains. Calling every R a checkpoint retry is wrong on clear screens.
